security_spec.violation_condition: When XiangShan RTL implements the cbo.zero instruction's envcfg-based access control using the pre-fix logic: (1) S-mode is never checked against menvcfg.CBZE, allowing S-mode to execute cbo.zero when menvcfg.CBZE=0 (S-mode access should trap with IllegalInstruction); (2) M-mode incorrectly traps when menvcfg.CBZE=0 despite M-mode always having access; (3) VU-mode uses a logical-OR gate (henvcfg.CBZE | senvcfg.CBZE)==0 instead of requiring BOTH bits to be 1, allowing VU-mode to execute cbo.zero when only one of henvcfg.CBZE or senvcfg.CBZE is set; (4) CSR reads of menvcfg/senvcfg/henvcfg proceed without misa.S/misa.H guards, potentially accessing unimplemented CSR registers that read as garbage on hardware lacking those extensions.
security_spec.summary: cbo.zero access check in RTL has missing/miscoded privilege gates: S-mode access not gated by menvcfg.CBZE (privilege escape), M-mode falsely denied, VU-mode granted on partial envcfg enable, and missing misa.S/misa.H CSR-existence guards
